sources.title: IFEval Leaderboard (August 2026): Qwen3.5-27B Leads at 95%
sources.snippet: Instruction-Following Eval (IFEval) leaderboard across 26 AI models. Qwen3.5-27B leads with 95%. A benchmark of 541 prompts built from 25 verifiable instruction types. It tests whether a model follows checkable constraints such as keyword, length, casing, and response-format requirements.
